name: farmer practice
description: timing and amount based on the farmer's own judgement

name: calendar
description: irrigation on fixed dates or at a fixed interval

name: crop stage
description: irrigation at set crop growth stages

name: crop water requirement
description: amount based on computed crop water requirement (ETc)

name: soil water balance
description: scheduling with a soil water balance model

name: soil moisture sensor
description: scheduling based on soil moisture readings, e.g. capacitance or TDR sensors

name: tensiometer
description: scheduling based on soil water tension

name: wetting front detector
description: scheduling with a wetting front detector, e.g. FullStop

name: alternate wetting and drying
description: rice is re-flooded when the field water level drops to a threshold below the soil surface

name: deficit irrigation
description: irrigation deliberately below the full crop water requirement

name: advisory service
description: scheduling based on advice from an extension or ICT advisory service
